core.headline: Two-bedroom mid-terrace house, Dartford – Shared Ownership
core.summary: Shared Ownership opportunity in Dartford: 40% share for £130,000, rent £487 per month on the unsold share. Mid-terrace house with rear garden, two parking spaces and gas central heating.
core.listing:
A two-bedroom mid-terrace house at 14 Wren Close, Dartford DA1, available for Shared Ownership at £130,000 for a 40% share. Rent on the unsold share is £487 per month. The full market value is £325,000. The tenure is leasehold with 990 years remaining. Ground rent is peppercorn. The service charge is £312 per year (2026/27 estimate).

The accommodation comprises one reception room and a bathroom. The property has gas central heating. Outside there is a rear garden and driveway parking for two cars.

Mains electricity, mains water (metered) and mains sewerage are connected. Broadband is FTTC. Mobile signal provides good outdoor coverage on major networks.
